purpose: Fresh two-agent MAPPO baseline on the Town05 four-direction two-lane parallel and required-merge task. Town02 checkpoints are historical evidence and are not resumable into this contract.

parameter_rationale.migration_boundary: Town05 changes map geometry, task distribution and legal lane-change semantics, so the run must start fresh; Town02 optimizer, RNG and checkpoint state cannot be resumed.
parameter_rationale.scenario_design: Roads 44 and 3 supply four balanced directions. Each direction contains stationary parallel, rolling parallel, staggered rear-closing and required-merge tasks with mirrored agent identities. Non-merge families preserve each agent's starting lane with per-agent target zones; merge families deliberately share one narrow target lane.
parameter_rationale.episode_horizon: The Town05 routes are approximately 40-45 m. A 500-step horizon is 50 simulated seconds, retaining generous recovery time while halving the Town02 1000-step compute ceiling.
parameter_rationale.lane_change_semantics: Crossing a Broken lane separator is a legal lane change. Solid, curb, unknown or empty lane-invasion events remain safety violations, and crosswalk events remain collisions.
parameter_rationale.lane_center_semantics: Centering and lane-deviation are computed independently against each vehicle's current CARLA Driving-lane waypoint centre. They never use the two-lane road median or the shared navigation-goal centre; after a legal merge the reference naturally becomes the destination-lane centre.
parameter_rationale.optimization: R1 signed-longitudinal action, reward v3, AgentConditionedCritic, ValueNorm, normalized Huber loss and PPO parameters remain unchanged to isolate the map and scenario migration.
parameter_rationale.seed_policy: Seed 42 is the engineering pilot. Seeds 123 and 2024 remain blocked until the Town05 seed-42 milestone gate releases them.
